671:t_017:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「I fight to protect you... My wings will carry your feelings as I fly! Forever!」

671:t_018:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Not to you...! Not to someone who toys with love like you!」

671:t_018:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「I always give my all when I fly toward my goal!」

671:t_018:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ランカ$$ is the same! Even without me, she has her song!」

671:t_018:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「So I'll protect her song, even if I can't stay by her side!」

671:t_018:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「Reach out your hand, $$ランカ$$!」

671:t_019:2.en:
$$ランカ$$
「$$アルト$$! I knew you'd come to save me!」

671:t_019:5.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Be honest with your feelings too, $$アルト$$, just as I told you mine.」

671:t_019:7.en:
$$ランカ$$
「I'll keep singing... because you protected my song, $$アルト$$.」

671:t_020:1.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「$$ミカゲ$$! We will enfold your sorrow!」

671:t_021:0.en:
$$クレア$$
「$$エレメントチェンジ$$! $$ミコノ・スズシロ$$, transfer to the $$ゲパルト$$!」

671:t_022:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
「This is... love, a heart that brings happiness to everyone!」

671:t_024:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「I can tell...! $$ミカゲ$$'s closed heart has stirred, just a little!」

671:t_024:1.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Heh... You do understand love after all.」

671:t_024:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I won't accept it! I will never accept this!」

671:t_025:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh heh... There is nowhere for you to escape in this space.」

671:t_026:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What the heck was that?!」

671:t_026:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「The palm appeared first, then the arm extended from it back toward the body!」

671:t_026:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That's his technique! He reverses causality... in other words, cause and effect!」

671:t_026:3.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「So the effect, the hit, happens before its cause, the attack!」

671:t_026:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「There's no way to dodge that!」

671:t_026:5.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「There's no way to dodge that!」

671:t_026:6.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「There's no way to dodge that!」

671:t_026:7.en:
$$桂$$
「The best defense is a good offense! We have to take him down before he gets us!」

671:t_026:8.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Do you think such a shallow ploy will work?」

671:t_027:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Correct. You cannot catch even my shadow.」

671:t_027:4.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「His attacks can't be dodged, and his movements are completely unpredictable!」

671:t_027:5.en:
$$チコ$$
「How are we supposed to fight an enemy like that?!」

671:t_027:6.en:
$$赤木$$
「Don't lose your nerve! He seems to be taunting us, so he doesn't intend to jump very far!」

671:t_027:7.en:
$$いぶき$$
「That's a coolheaded assessment, especially for you, $$赤木$$!」

671:t_027:8.en:
$$タケル$$
「Then we'll just keep up with him!」

671:t_027:9.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh heh heh... Without wings, you cannot leap as I do.」

671:t_027:11.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'll show you how that arrogance will cost you your life!」

671:t_027:12.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「It is useless, Wingless. My triangle of love, hatred and despair is stronger than steel.」

671:t_027:13.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「No matter what you do, the likes of you can never shatter these feelings!」

671:t_100:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A mere child could never understand my love, hatred or despair.」

671:t_100:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「It's true I'm a child... I don't really understand what it means to love someone...」

671:t_100:2.en:
$$正太郎$$
「But I do know that you're evil!」

671:t_100:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Do not judge me, an $$天翅$$, as evil by your Wingless standards!」

671:t_100:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「It doesn't matter if you're an $$天翅$$ or a human! Evil is evil, and you're our enemy!」

671:t_101:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You twin of light and darkness! You speak as though you understand!」

671:t_101:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「Your love hurts others! How can that be love?!」

671:t_101:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「If you cherish someone, that feeling should give rise to boundless kindness!」

671:t_101:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Silence! Then this battle will show you which will engulf the world, your love or my hatred!」

671:t_102:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「Loving someone gives you the power to blow hatred clean away!」

671:t_102:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Spiral Man! Do you intend to deny my love?!」

671:t_102:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「I don't! But if you're trying to destroy our love... the world $$ニア$$ and I love, that's another story!」

671:t_102:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「I swear on this drill! Our love won't lose to your broken love!」

671:t_102:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Silence! Beyond Tengen Toppa lies the Heavenly Prison... You will die here before you reach it!」

671:t_103:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Big Sis and Coach's strong, gentle love gave us courage!」

671:t_103:1.en:
$$カズミ$$
「But your love makes the world suffer!」

671:t_103:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Do not compare mere Wingless love to mine!」

671:t_103:3.en:
$$カズミ$$
「You're a pitiable person who cannot forgive anyone...」

671:t_103:5.en:
$$カズミ$$
「So we will save you by shattering your hatred!」

671:t_103:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Then we will show you humanity's power... and our feelings!」

671:t_103:8.en:
$$カズミ$$
「And we will make you remember the true power of love!」

671:t_104:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You are a machine! You could never understand the depths of my feelings!」

671:t_104:1.en:
$$ノノ$$
「It's true that $$ノノ$$ has a mechanical body. But a burning heart beats within it!」

671:t_104:2.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「It's true that $$ノノ$$ has a mechanical body. But a burning heart beats within it!」
